zh: 侧栏「任务」列表默认不再混入微信 / WeLink 频道会话，只显示自己的对话与桌面 Agent 会话。
点击侧栏「频道会话」即可查看全部频道对话；在筛选里选中微信或 WeLink 时也会并入列表。
任务计数随之只统计当前显示的条目，列表更清爽。
en: The sidebar Tasks list no longer mixes in WeChat / WeLink channel chats by default, showing only your own chats and desktop agent sessions.
Open Channels in the sidebar to see channel chats, or pick WeChat or WeLink in the list filter to merge them in.
The task count now reflects only the rows shown, keeping the list tidy.
